messages:
maria_cs: HarperGrove reports intermittent p99 spikes on embeddings since ~2026-03-16 03:00 UTC. Values up to 7-9s. They see it mostly on batch embeddings requests (>64 items). Customer asks for temporary mitigation (allowlist/reservation) and wants repro steps. Raising to support.

vikram_support: Thanks — can you paste a sample request payload + tenant id? Also need last 15m of route-level p95/p99 from console. Did they change batching on client side?

maria_cs: Tenant: hg-4321. Sample payload (trimmed):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ model: "open-embed-1", inputs: ["..." x 128] }
```
They said they recently increased batch_size to 128. Attached trace id: trace=tr_0b9a. Console p95=420ms p99=5.8s for /embeds route (past 15m).

andy_runtime: Increasing batch size to 128 will definitely amplify KV cache churn and increase tail. Can we check per-tenant queue length and interleaving stats on node pool serving hg-4321? Also look for re-quantization fallback in logs.

kevin_sre: Running quick query now — @andy_runtime pulling per-tenant queue depth, looks like spikes correlating with other tenant hg-9902 on same pool. Noisy neighbor pattern. Also seeing occasional OOM-ish GC pauses on one worker.

vikram_support: Options: 1) ephemeral reservation for hg-4321 (small capacity reserved, reduces contention), 2) temporary per-tenant throttling (cap batch_size or concurrency), 3) ask customer to reduce batch_size to 64 while we investigate. Which is fastest?

maria_cs: Customer prefers minimal code changes — asks for platform-side fix (reservation or allowlist).

andy_runtime: I can add ephemeral reservation of 2 slots to the pool for 30m. That should drop p99 to ~600-800ms. Applying now.

deploy-bot: Config change applied: reservation added tenant=hg-4321 slots=2 duration=30m by andy_runtime

vikram_support: Good — can we also enable prefix/KV caching for embeddings on their route? That's low-risk and may help immediate tails.

andy_runtime: Enabled prefix cache config: `route: /v1/embeddings, cache: prefix, ttl: 600s` — applied.

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: prefix_cache=true for tenant=hg-4321 by andy_runtime

kevin_sre: Early telemetry: p99 dropped from 5.8s -> 720ms in last 5m. p95 stable ~350ms. Queue depth for hg-9902 still high; will open noisy-tenant ticket.

maria_cs: Sharing update with HarperGrove — they see much better numbers. They asked for confirmation whether reservation is persistent or temporary.

andy_runtime: It's ephemeral 30m. We'll follow up with options: reserved reservation plan or capacity commit via CS. I'll set a follow-up to discuss long-term.

vikram_support: Filing support ticket: #INC-2026-1487 — noisy neighbor on pool 4 causing embed tail. Owner: kevin_sre. Next check-in in 20m.

kevin_sre: I'll also add a patch to node allocator to prefer spreading heavy embedding tenants across pools; low-risk change. ETA for rollout tomorrow.

maria_cs: Thanks team :tada: HarperGrove is happy for the moment. Closing loop with customer, will post transcript. /cc @kevin_sre @andy_runtime

vikram_support: keeping open until we validate 1h post-change.
